# vastdata_compute_cluster_services (Data Source)

Kubernetes services in a compute cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_compute_cluster_services" "tf_test_cluster_services" {
  compute_cluster_name = "tf-test-cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `compute_cluster_id` (Number) Compute cluster ID. Provide this or compute_cluster_name.
- `compute_cluster_name` (String) Compute cluster name. Used to look up the cluster ID when compute_cluster_id is not set.

### Read-Only

- `services` (Attributes List) Kubernetes services in the compute cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))

<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_ip` (String) Cluster IP address.
- `created_at` (String) Service creation timestamp.
- `external_ip` (String) External IP address.
- `name` (String) Service name.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace where the service is located.
- `service_type` (String) Service type (ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, etc.).
